label: Flowchart
description: An animated flowchart whose boxed nodes pop in and arrowed connectors draw on in sequence, laid out left-to-right or top-down from nodes and edges.

color.description: Optional flat chip color (hex): sticky-note chip with auto dark/light text -- the whiteboard look on light backdrops.

edge_color.label: Edge Color
edge_color.description: Optional connector/arrow color (defaults to brand accent). Use a dark neutral on light whiteboard-style backdrops.
